create_timer_instance: create a Timer instance to start measuring elapsed time for a code block
run_timer_tic_toc: run the Timer tic and toc methods to measure and print elapsed time with FPS
test_timer_average: test the Timer toc method with average=True to get the mean elapsed time across calls
review_timer_reset: review the Timer reset method to clear total_time, calls, and average_time state
summarize_timer_class: summarize the Timer class which provides tic, toc, and reset methods for timing code blocks
